note: Generated by Tools/world/build_encounters.js from regions.json, region_graph.json, species.json and population.json. Do not edit by hand; hand-written text lives in THEMES in the generator. Docs: 10_World/encounter_tables.md.

zones.roadside: Within 60 m of a road, pass or settlement gate. Calm creatures only. Never inside a settlement.
zones.wild: Open land in the region. The middle of the rank band.
zones.deep: Ruins, dens, lairs, caves and deep forest. The top of the band, hostile first.
zones.night: Replaces wild/deep between dusk and dawn. Hostile residents seen at night.

rules.groupRule: group = [min,max] enemies per encounter; the director rolls inside it and never exceeds the ring cap below.
rules.borderBleedWeight: borderBleed entries add to wild and roadside tables at weight 1 each: a stray from the next region, never above this region's top rank.
rules.tyrantRule: A region's Tyrant is never in a random table. It appears only through the siege system (siege_waves.json) and its lair.
rules.safeRule: No random combat inside settlements, within 150 m of an inn or waystone, or on a road within noCombatWithinMeters of either end.
rules.uniqueRule: Unique and Story-tier population entries are excluded from every table.

theme.pacing: The first real pressure. Farm tracks stay calm by day; the ruins and fens are the front line of the Oathless Baron.
theme.signature: slimes in the grass, skeleton patrols on the old Royal Valley roads, goblin raiders near the farms
theme.avoid: no Pack groups on the Whisperwood road itself
